articles.summary: Where is Alnylam located? Our corporate headquarters and research laboratories are located in Cambridge, MA, with our large-scale manufacturing facilities located in Cambridge, MA, and Norton, MA. The European business offices are located in Maidenhead, UK, and Zug, Switzerland, with satellite offices in Munich, Germany; Amsterdam, Netherlands; Vienna, Austria; Paris, France; Milan, Italy; Madrid, Spain; and Stockholm, Sweden. Other global offices include Toyko, Japan; Sao Paulo, Brazil; and Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. ozaki Fri, 11 Oct 2019 - 16:43
